entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2 09-11-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2. The petitioner is the husband of the opposite party no. 2 who is ready to keep his wife with full honour and dignity.

3. The petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Rajauli P.S. Case No. 170 of 2022 dated 17.04.2022, instituted for the offence punishable under Sections 341, 323, 498A, 354, 506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and also under Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

4. Issue notice to opposite party no. 2 under Speed Post with A/D as well as through ordinary process for which requisites etc. must be filed within one week after Chhath Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.72753 of 2023(2) dt.09-11-2023 holidays.
5.
The case be listed upon service of notice or appearance of the opposite party no. 2, whichever is earlier.
